newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's London Club reconciliation going well.
newsitem.headline: Russia's London Club reconciliation going well.

text.p: Reconciliation of Russia's $35 billion debt to the London Club of bank creditors is proceeding well, Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov said on Tuesday.

"Reconciliation is going on at a normal rate," Kasyanov told Reuters. "Vneshekonombank is carrying out consultations with individual groups of creditors on solving technical questions ... to speed up the process of confirming the reconciled debt. Our estimate is that the work is going on in a more or less normal rate."
He did not say how much of the debt had been reconciled so far.
In March the Finance Ministry said it had reconciled $12 billion of the debt.
The minimum necessary sum for closing the London Club rescheduling is $20 billion.
